The '''DP20 gunship''' or '''DP20 frigate''', commonly called the '''Corellian gunship''', was one of the few dedicated [[Warship/Legends|warship]] designs produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], and was the most common member of the Corellian gunship product line.<ref name="Starships" /> Though small and compact, it was fast and carried heavy firepower for a ship of its size and class.

==Characteristics==
[[File:CorellianGunship-SotG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A DP20 frigate]]
Unlike its cousin, the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] had minimal cargo space and almost no space for passengers or troops. These small ships were designed to be only two things: fast and deadly. Engines consumed nearly half of the gunship's interior space. What little room was left was used for [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] and weapons.

Armed with eight double [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] tubes, and six [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] gunship was effective against both larger [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], though it was primarily used against the latter. These ships were 120 meters long. Each one carried a crew of 45, along with 46 [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]. They were equipped with Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].

==History==
The DP20 was originally designed for the fleet of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> These vessels saw extensive use among the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleets, although some were also seen in the hands of independent operators, such as [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] factions and other fringe groups. Local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces also utilized the class.<ref name="TABS" /> The Rebel Alliance, in need of a small, fast attack vessel, decided to purchase a few of these starships after witnessing a group of pirates use them to hijack an Imperial shipment guarded by several Imperial fighters and bombers.<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> At least one of these vessels was wrecked in the [[Korteen asteroid belt]] by [[Quarg]]'s father and his space wreckers.<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (1977) 13|''Star Wars'' (1977) 13]]</ref>

Approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|twelve months before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="TFU2c">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> DP20 frigates were among the fleet led by the Rebel [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] when it fell under [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|attack]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], and for its retaliatory [[assault on Kamino]].<ref name="TFU2">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

Following the Rebel Alliance's [[Battle of Toprawa|first victory]] over the Galactic Empire, the pirate [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack's]] [[Crimson Jack's crew/Legends|crew]] employed a DP20 frigate to fight off the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] complement of an [[Crimson Jack's battlecruiser|Imperial cruiser]] crippled in that battle, which he then seized for himself.<ref name="SW12" />

During the [[Yavin blockade|Imperial blockade]] of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]],<ref name="SW35">[[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]]</ref> DP20 frigates, alongside [[Rebel ship of the line|larger Rebel warships]], were part of an Alliance fleet led by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] through the [[Feswe Corridor|asteroid corridor]] to defend their supply [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]] from the Imperial-aligned [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]]. Though the supposed attack was in fact a ruse to draw in the Rebel fleet and incapacitate it with house [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Silas Tagge/Legends|Silas Tagge's]] [[Omega Frost/Legends|Omega Frost]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], sabotage to the device by the Rebel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a breach of [[Comm unit/Legends|comms]] silence by the Tagges' crew allowed the Rebel frigates and [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] runners to [[Battle of the Corridor|destroy]] the Tagge [[Mining Explorer]].<ref name="SW34">[[Star Wars (1977) 34|''Star Wars'' (1977) 34]]</ref> After the [[evacuation of Yavin]], DP20 frigates were among the Rebel fleet dispatched to the wealthy planet [[Arrochar]] in hopes of establishing a new base.<ref name="SW15">[[Star Wars (2013) 15|''Star Wars'' (2013) 15]]</ref>

After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Corellian gunship ''[[Loose Cannon]]'' was used by a group of [[Loose Cannon pirates|pirates]] in a [[Mission to acquire black market bacta|raid]] on the [[Azzameen family]]'s assets. Drawing the Azzameens in with the promise of black-market [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], the ''Loose Cannon'' exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and engaged the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|Firespray fighter]] ''[[Andrasta]]'' and [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 transport]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''. Though the gunship inflicted significant damage to the ''Andrasta'', it succumbed to their attack and combusted from within.<ref name="XWAOSG" />

New Republic [[Captain/Legends|captains]] [[Afyon]] and [[Sarin Virgilio]] both began their careers with the Rebel Alliance aboard Corellian gunships, as [[Executive officer/Legends|first]] and [[Third officer/Legends|third officers]], respectively. Virgilio's gunship was the veteran of many engagements since [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and recovered the six surviving members of a [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] involved in the theft of the [[Death Star II plans]].<ref name="TTSB" />

During the [[Bakura Incident]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="EC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> five Corellian gunships&mdash;the ''[[Ensaiav]]'', ''[[Ghorman's Honor]]'', [[Mastala (DP20 gunship)|''Mastala'']], ''[[Telsor]]'', and ''[[Walerv]]''&mdash;were part of the [[Bakura task force|Rebel task force]] sent to defend the Imperial-held planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] from the extra-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]]. The Alliance group formed a [[Bakura Truce|truce]] with the world's defenders, whose forces included six Corellian gunships of their own, though four were lost in the initial [[invasion of Bakura]].<ref name="TABS" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the New Republic [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''[[New Hope]]''<ref name="EC" /> and [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] [[Mercy (hospital ship)|''Mercy'']] had a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of Corellian Gunships as part of their escort.<ref name="DFRA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

DP20 frigates [[Second Battle of Coruscant|destroyed]] in the [[Imperial Civil War]] were still present as wreckage during the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] crew's mission<ref name="DE1">[[Dark Empire 1|''Dark Empire'' 1]]</ref> to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], while the New Republic<ref name="EC" /> stationed the frigates at their stronghold [[Pinnacle Base]] on the [[Da Soocha V|fifth moon]] of [[Da Soocha]] in the [[Cyax system/Legends|Cyax system]],<ref name="DE2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref> from which they were deployed to fight in the [[Battle of Calamari]].<ref name="DE3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> At Pinnacle Base, a DP20 frigate crew reported the arrival of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|flagship]], and at least one of the frigates was [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|consumed]] by the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] [[Force storm (wormhole)|Force storm]].<ref name="DE6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref> At least one DP20 frigate relocated to the ancient [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Nespis VIII]] following the [[destruction of Da Soocha V]] by the Imperial [[Galaxy Gun]] superweapon, fleeing once again when Nespis too was [[Destruction of the Nespis VIII spaceport|targeted]] by the weapon.<ref name="EE1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blockade_Runner_Sketchbook.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The DP20 began as a concept for the ''Millennium Falcon'' and later, the Rebel Blockade Runner.]]
The gunship was first described in detail in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' in [[1990]],<ref name="RAS1">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> but Rebel gunships based on the same concept-art designs first appeared in the [[Star Wars (1977) 12|twelfth issue]] of [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel's ''Star Wars'']] comics in [[1978]]:<ref name="SW12" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' confirmed these to be Corellian gunships by using an image of one to illustrate its "Corellian gunship" entry.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|1|142|Corellian Gunship}}</ref>

''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'', an adventure for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]], featured the complete deck plans of a Corellian gunship, ''[[Handree]]''.<ref name="IC">''[[The Isis Coordinates]]''</ref>

The common designation of this vessel was the "Corellian Gunship" before the revised version of [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'']] introduced the designation DP-20 or DP20. The term "Corellian Gunship" became a classification.<ref name="Starships" />
